description: This file contains the implementation of jQuery's event handling system, including event registration, removal, triggering, and normalization of event objects.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Registers an event handler for specified event types on an element.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes event handlers from an element based on specified criteria.

methods.name: trigger
methods.description: Triggers a specified event type on an element, optionally with data.

methods.name: dispatch
methods.description: Dispatches an event to the appropriate handlers.

methods.name: handlers
methods.description: Determines the list of handlers to execute for an event.

methods.name: fix
methods.description: Normalizes a native event object into a jQuery.Event object.

methods.name: simulate
methods.description: Simulates an event of a given type on an element.
